concepts.summary: Double Stick: both inside receivers run Stick at 5 and both outside receivers run Flat at 3, so the same picture shows up on each side and the QB works one side. The back is the third option on a Check Thru.
concepts.qb: 3 step. Pick the better side before the snap and work Stick to Flat there.

positions.Y: Stick at 5 yds from the -5- spot
positions.F: Stick at 5 yds from the -5- spot

concepts.summary: One-side Stick: the tagged man (F, Z, X or Y on the call line) runs the Stick at 5, the man next to him runs Flat at 3, and a third receiver works over the ball (OTB). The backside outside receiver runs Thunder as a Yes/No throw and the back checks slow to an outlet.
concepts.progression: 1 Stick, 2 Flat, 3 OTB. Backside Thunder is a Yes/No alert.
concepts.qb: 3 step. Decide on the backside Thunder (Yes/No) before the snap, otherwise work Stick, Flat, OTB.

positions.tagged: Stick at 5 yds (the letter on the call line: F, Z, X or Y)
positions.third frontside man: OTB, over the ball; which letter varies by cell, unclear
positions.backside outside: Thunder: break at 6 yds with a quick 5-step stem vs off coverage, stop at 8 yds vs press or cloud. Yes/No. Split rule: +4 to the boundary, +2 to the field or middle; last cell says cheat the split +2 outside the hash

alerts: Thunder is a Yes/No throw on the backside
Thunder receiver: quick 5 steps against off coverage, 8 yd stop against press or cloud
Split: +4 to the boundary, +2 to the field or middle

concepts.summary: Stick plus Thunder on both sides: inside men run Stick at 5, outside men run Thunder at 6 or 8 with a max split, mirrored so the QB picks a side. The T.O. version turns the Stick into a Stick Nod and the Thunder into a Thunder take-off, with the back on a Check Option.
concepts.progression: 1 Stick, 2 Thunder (each side). T.O.: 1 Stick Nod, 2 Thunder T.O.
concepts.qb: 3 step. Thunder is Yes/No; the Stick side gets worked otherwise.

positions.X: Thunder at 6 or 8 yds, max split +4; T.O. version is Thunder T.O.
positions.Z: Thunder at 6 or 8 yds, max split +4; T.O. version is Thunder T.O.
positions.Y: Stick at 5 yds; T.O. version is Stick Nod at 5
positions.F: Stick at 5 yds; T.O. version is Stick Nod at 5
positions.H: Check Thru, outlet at 3 yds; T.O. version is Check Option outlet at 5

alerts: Thunder: Yes/No, max split +4

concepts.summary: Outside receivers widen and run Omaha, a 4-step route at 5 yds that turns into a fade against cloud; inside receivers run Stick at 5. Mirrored, with the back on a Check Thru. The T.O. version has the Omaha man sell it in 3 steps and take off, with Stick Nods inside and a Check Option outlet.
concepts.qb: 3 step. Omaha converts to a fade vs cloud, so read the corner.

positions.X: Widen, Omaha in 4 steps at 5 yds, fade vs cloud; T.O. version is Omaha T.O. (3 steps then 4)
positions.Z: Widen, Omaha in 4 steps at 5 yds, fade vs cloud; T.O. version is Omaha T.O.
positions.Y: Stick at 5 yds from the -5- spot; T.O. version is Stick Nod at 5
positions.F: Stick at 5 yds from the -5- spot; T.O. version is Stick Nod at 5
positions.H: Check Thru, outlet at 3 yds; T.O. version is Check Option outlet at 5

alerts: Omaha becomes a fade against cloud coverage

concepts.summary: 3x1 version of the Omaha and Stick pair: to the trips side the outside man widens and runs Omaha in 4 steps while the Sticks sit at 5. The single receiver runs Thunder on a max split with a Stomp alert, and the back checks thru to an outlet.
concepts.progression: 1 and 2 printed on the trips side (Stick and Omaha), a separate 1 on the backside Thunder; the exact order is unclear
concepts.qb: 3 step. Backside Thunder is a Yes/No, Stomp is the alert.

positions.trips inside: Stick at 5 yds (two Stick labels on the page, so both inside men appear to Stick)
positions.single receiver: Thunder at 6 or 8 yds, max split +4, alert Stomp

alerts: Backside Thunder with a Stomp alert
Thunder is Yes/No
Max split +4

concepts.summary: Stick plus Coin to the trips side: one inside man sits on a Stick at 5, another runs Coin at 5, and the outside man runs a Go as an alert. The single receiver runs Thunder (first cell) or widens for Omaha (second cell). The back checks thru.
concepts.progression: 1 Stick, 2 Coin (numbers 1 and 2 on the trips side, a separate 1 on the backside)
concepts.qb: 3 step. Go alert outside, Thunder Yes/No on the backside.

positions.single receiver: Thunder at 6 or 8 yds, max split +4, Yes/No (first cell); widen Omaha in 4 steps (second cell)

alerts: Go alert on the outside man
Thunder Yes/No

concepts.summary: The tagged man runs Arrow at 5 from the -5- spot with a Corner at 12 over the top of him as the alert. The other side carries the Bow pair: Flat at 3 and Basic at 12 to 14. Four progression numbers are printed.
concepts.progression: Numbers 1 to 4 on the page; Flat carries 1 and Arrow and Corner carry 1 and 2 on their side, exact order unclear
concepts.qb: 3 step. Corner is the alert over the Arrow.

positions.tagged: Arrow at 5 yds from the -5- spot (Z, Y or F on the call line)
positions.fifth man: a second Arrow at 5 yds appears in each cell; which letter is unclear

alerts: Corner at 12 yds is the alert

concepts.summary: Empty Stick with four backside packages. The tagged man runs Stick at 5. Bow puts an Arrow at 5 and a Basic at 12 to 14 behind two Flats. Bullet is a China flat at 3 to 5 with a Dart, read as it unfolds. Cheddar is Skinny, Pivot and Diagonal with a 7-step 10-yd alert. Dairy is two Diagonals, a Skinny and an Arrow, 7 or 5 steps at 10 yds.
concepts.progression: Numbers 1 to 5 printed per cell; Stick and the Flat beside it carry the low numbers, order of the rest unclear
concepts.qb: 3 step. Bullet is a read; Cheddar and Dairy carry a deep alert.

positions.tagged: Stick at 5 yds (X, Z or Y on the call line)
positions.bow: Flat 3 yds, Flat 3 yds, Arrow 5 yds, Basic 12 to 14 yds
positions.bullet: China flat 3 to 5 yds, Dart 5 yds, Flat 3 yds, Basic 12 to 14 yds
positions.cheddar: Skinny, Pivot 5 yds, Diagonal, Flat 3 yds; 7 steps 10 yds alert
positions.dairy: Diagonal, Diagonal, Skinny, Arrow 5 yds, Flat 3 yds; 7 (5) steps 10 yds

alerts: Bullet is read on the move
Cheddar and Dairy carry a 7-step 10-yd alert

concepts.summary: Same four packages as the empty Stick page but built on a Spot at 5 from a 3x1 set, with the Spot man told to work wide. Bow, Bullet (read), Cheddar and Dairy fill the other spots the same way.
concepts.progression: Numbers 1 to 5 per cell; Spot is low in the order, the rest unclear
concepts.qb: 3 step. Bullet is a read; Cheddar and Dairy carry the 7-step alert.

positions.tagged: Spot at 5 yds, wide (Y, X or F on the call line)
positions.bow: Flat 3 yds, Arrow 5 yds, Basic 12 to 14 yds
positions.bullet: China flat 3 to 5 yds, Dart 5 yds, Basic 12 to 14 yds
positions.cheddar: Skinny, Pivot, Diagonal, 7 steps 10 yds alert

alerts: Bullet is a read
7-step 10-yd alert on Cheddar and Dairy

concepts.summary: Two quick empty-style concepts with F on a Coin at 5. Lions is Snags at 5 across the board with a Sluggo option as the alert (3 steps then 2). Simba is Slants: outside man a 3-step Slant, inside men Inside Slants, with a Go alert and the Thunder split rule.
concepts.progression: Lions: 1 Snag, 2 Snag, 1 on the far side. Simba: 1 Slant, 2 Inside Slant, 3 Inside Slant
concepts.qb: 3 step. Lions: Sluggo is an option alert. Simba: Go alert, Yes/No.

positions.lions receivers: Snag at 5 yds; one outside man has a Sluggo option (3 steps, 2 steps) as the alert
positions.simba outside: Slant in 3 steps; Go alert, Yes/No; split +4 to the boundary, +2 to the field or middle

alerts: Lions: Sluggo option alert
Simba: Go alert, Yes/No

concepts.summary: The tagged man runs Lookie at 5, a quick choice route off a straight stem. Chops is the rest of the empty picture: a Stick China in 4 steps, a Stick Nod at 5, and a Go alert on a max split.
concepts.progression: 1 Lookie, 2 Stick China, 3 Stick Nod; Go is the alert
concepts.qb: 3 step. Go alert on the max-split man.

positions.tagged: Lookie at 5 yds, a sped-up choice route with a vertical stem (F, Y or X on the call line)
positions.chops 1: Stick China at 5 yds in 4 steps

alerts: Go alert, max split +4

concepts.summary: Empty quick concept built on a Faulk at 5 with a Shallow Cross under it, two Dunnys at 5 and a C.O. at 5. A Go alert sits outside. Against a known man look the Faulk becomes the first read.
concepts.progression: 1 Shallow Cross, 2 Faulk, 3 Dunny, 4 C.O.; vs known man the Faulk is 1
concepts.qb: 3 step. If you know it is man, start on the Faulk.

positions.tagged: Faulk at 5 yds (Y or F on the call line)

alerts: Go alert
Known man: Faulk is the first read
